scope: Wild-flora seeds currently conserved in eligible seed/germplasm banks physically located in Spain.

orientation.REPRESENTACION_EX_SITU_100: 0=minimal relative ex-situ representation; 100=very high relative representation under the active frozen STIMES distribution
orientation.DEFICIT_EX_SITU_100: 100 - REPRESENTACION_EX_SITU_100; 0=minimal contribution to collection urgency, 100=maximal contribution

raw_variables.P: n_poblaciones_representadas válidas derivadas de unidades operativas población-localización auditables

percentile_method.definition: Sort ascending; h=(n-1)*p; linearly interpolate between floor(h) and ceil(h).
percentile_method.reason: Deterministic continuous empirical percentile implementation suitable for a frozen version; changing it requires a new model version.

zero_denominator_rule: A real annual model snapshot cannot be frozen with P99_A<=0 or P99_P<=0. If the empirical universe genuinely contains zero for one dimension, model calibration is PENDIENTE_DE_DEFINICION rather than dividing by zero.
individual_refresh_rule: Taxon-specific refreshes always reuse the frozen P99_A/P99_P of the active dated model snapshot.
annual_refresh_rule: A complete annual universe refresh recalculates the distribution and emits a new dated snapshot when adopted; historical snapshots and scores remain immutable.
meaning_of_100: Very high representation relative to the frozen STIMES universe and model distribution; never biological completeness or complete genetic representation.
reason_active_snapshot_pending: The national bank active universe and taxon-by-bank coverage are not yet completely verified; real P99_A/P99_P must not be fabricated from partial evidence.
